vocabulary.meaning_en: normal, common, part of daily life (one word)
vocabulary.note_ar: كلمة واحدة، صفة تأتي قبل الاسم
vocabulary.note_en: One word; an adjective before a noun.
Two words; usually after the verb.
vocabulary.example: I go to the gym every day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the things you do regularly in the same order
vocabulary.example: I'm tired of my everyday routine.
Work, chores, that kind of thing.
What are you up to today?

vocabulary.meaning_en: recently; in the last few days or weeks

vocabulary.example: My life has been feeling boring.
Try something new at least once a week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: do things in a new way (informal)
vocabulary.example: We need to change things up.
Let's break out of our everyday pattern.
We have the same pattern every week.
Exercise is part of my daily life.

vocabulary.meaning_en: if you practise a lot, you become very good

fine_lines.title: everyday vs every day
fine_lines.explanation_ar: everyday (كلمة واحدة) صفة تعني عادي أو يومي وتأتي قبل الاسم: everyday clothes. every day (كلمتان) تعني كل يوم وتأتي غالبًا بعد الفعل: I study every day.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Everyday" (one word) is an adjective = normal; it comes before a noun. "Every day" (two words) = each day; it usually comes after the verb.

examples.sentence: I wear these shoes every day.

fine_lines.title: every day vs once a week
fine_lines.explanation_ar: every day = كل يوم. once a week = مرة في الأسبوع.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Every day" = 7 times a week. "Once a week" = 1 time a week.

examples.sentence: I go to the gym every day.
We eat out once a week.

expressions.phrase: What are you up to today?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking a friend about their plans.
expressions.example: Hey, what are you up to this weekend?
Nothing new. Just the usual everyday routine.

expressions.phrase: I'm so tired of my everyday routine.
expressions.meaning_en: Saying you are bored of the same things.
expressions.example: I'm tired of eating the same food.

expressions.phrase: It's good to do different things sometimes.
expressions.meaning_ar: من الجيد أن تفعل أشياء مختلفة أحيانًا.
expressions.example: It's good to visit new places sometimes.

expressions.phrase: We need to change things up.
expressions.example: Same café every day? We need to change things up.

expressions.phrase: How about we do something new this week?
expressions.meaning_ar: ما رأيك أن نفعل شيئًا جديدًا هذا الأسبوع؟
expressions.example: How about we try a new restaurant?
A walk in the park? Let's do it!

expressions.meaning_en: You are happy about a future plan.
expressions.example: The trip is next week. I'm looking forward to it.

grammar.title: everyday (adjective) + noun
grammar.explanation_ar: everyday صفة، لذلك تأتي قبل الاسم: everyday life, everyday clothes, everyday chores.
grammar.explanation_en: "Everyday" is an adjective, so it goes before a noun.

grammar.title: verb + every day (time phrase)
grammar.explanation_ar: every day عبارة زمنية تعني كل يوم، وتأتي عادة بعد الفعل أو في آخر الجملة.
grammar.explanation_en: "Every day" is a time phrase; it usually goes after the verb or at the end.
examples: I go to the gym every day.
We do the same things every day.

questions.question: "Everyday" is ...
choices: a time phrase of two words

questions.question: "What are you up to today?" means ...
We should try something new at least ____ a week.
"Practice makes perfect." means ...
choices: If you practise a lot, you get very good.
questions.explanation_en: Practising a lot makes you very good.
